authMode.description: none: one implicit principal, `owner`. multi-user: principals are the app's accounts (spec/v0_2/auth.md).

accountUrl.description: Path of the framework's account page on this app (sign-in, approve an agent, connected agents). A client sends a person there; it never asks for their password itself.

appVersion.description: Optional, non-normative. An opaque marker of the app's own CODE version — the View it serves and the source it is built from. schemaVersion covers the MODEL only, so a UI-only change leaves it identical; appVersion is what a loaded page compares against to learn that the code it is running has been superseded. No client may require it.
